entry.title: A design bar for coercion-resistant custody, and where duressfeatures land against it
entry.summary: The analysis provided in the document available at [this source](https://github.com/Yuri-SVB/Great-Wall-docs/blob/95c75e518d7655da5dad2607da16d2d5079c0268/justification-and-economics/JUSTIFICATION.pdf) compares the statistics of jewelry theft to wrench attacks, highlighting the actuarial costs associated with Bitcoin self-custody versus self-custody of jewelry. The findings suggest that the financial burden of securing Bitcoin oneself exceeds that of securing physical valuables like jewelry. This insight suggests a reevaluation of the security methods currently used for Bitcoin custody, particularly those that expose users to risks such as "deadly-race-vulnerability." The recommendation is clear: avoid relying on less transparent and risk-prone security practices for asset protection.
